Connection writes both axes once; valid FLUENCY starts axis review; review pass/failure updates due dates, demotion, graduation and R/P-specific determined/conditional reservations atomically. Exact capacity reservation ID is read from frozen snapshot_json, validated and consumed once; completion is counted on the actual local day including midnight crossing. Target updates cancel only the affected axis review reservations and return it to today when it loses eligibility; if capacity allows, they atomically create a deterministic same-day task reservation, otherwise report the blocked axis without overbooking. The other axis schedule is preserved, and changes are rejected while the affected task is live. T12 DB chooser tests confirm target-requeued and review-demoted axes are schedulable on their reserved local dates. Jest settlement 10/10, score/review/settlement combined 35/35, full Jest 15 suites/170 tests; only two known pre-existing TypeScript errors remain. flow.db untouched.

nodes.expected: 可派候选优先级、当地日期调度、双轴41天容量预测与新词准入
nodes.actual: DB-driven schedule decisions handle due candidates, current-meaning material state, cooldown, training window, 42-day capacity and own active reservations. EMPTY availability handles reliable window starts and filtered future due timestamps; unknown 7-tick ETA remains null. New-word admission derives the conservative cooldown lower bound from the DB training window and now, rejects insufficient time/capacity/material, writes forecasts transactionally, rolls back on forced failure, and defaults ideal R/P completion dates to today while allowing different estimates. Capacity EMPTY now reports the earliest future local execution time when a due, material-ready candidate has capacity or its own active reservation within the 41-day horizon. The formal task service calls the DB chooser per word timezone inside its issuance transaction, returns the chooser EMPTY reason/next availability, and issues only the selected supported connection/choice candidate after a second transactional check. Due learning beats new introduction; due work requires an active reservation on the execution day, while overdue due_at remains unchanged. Material pending, cooldown, closed-window, and unsupported-stage responses are explicit. Target-updated axes receive a same-day one-task reservation when capacity allows and return explicit blocked-axis results when full; scheduler integration confirms the changed axis is selected. Review failure re-enters scheduler on the demoted axis date while preserving the other axis. Focused scheduler/service Jest 27/27 and settlement Jest 10/10; full Jest 15 suites/170 tests, diff-check pass; tsc retains two unrelated errors. flow.db was deleted and remains absent.
